Kanata Kara Anime Overview:

Noriko is an ordinary high school student who finds herself abruptly transported to an unfamiliar and perilous fantasy realm during her daily commute. Shortly after her arrival, she crosses paths with a skilled swordsman named Izark, who intervenes to save her from immediate danger. The two form an alliance to survive the harsh environment, though Noriko soon learns of a grim prophecy linking her presence to a destructive calamity tied to her companion. Bound by circumstance, they journey across a strange landscape filled with hostile forces and unknown threats while attempting to understand the prophecy surrounding them.

Japanese Title: 彼方から

Hotel Inhumans 2nd Season Anime Overview:

The narrative continues to unfold within a clandestine luxury establishment catering exclusively to the criminal underworld, assassins, and shadowy figures of high society. Managed by an elite and unfazed staff who adhere strictly to the rules of absolute discretion and hospitality, the facility serves as a neutral zone where dangerous clientele can rest, conduct business, or seek refuge from their pursuers. This second season further explores the complex interactions between the concierge personnel and their formidable guests, delving into the perilous circumstances, high-stakes requests, and unique histories that drive individuals within this dangerous subculture through the front doors.

Tempal: Item no Chikara Anime Overview:

Shin Youngwoo struggles through a difficult reality while trapped at the absolute bottom of the hierarchy in the immensely popular virtual reality massively multiplayer online role-playing game known as Satisfy. Known inside the digital world by his alias Grid, he spends his time doing grueling manual labor within the game, constantly burdened by debt and bad luck. That trajectory shifts entirely when he stumbles upon a rare, highly coveted quest that rewards him with a legendary class title called Pagma’s Successor. Granting him access to ancient blacksmithing techniques, legendary recipes, and the ability to craft equipment far superior to anything currently available on the server, this newfound vocation completely alters his virtual existence. Armed with exceptional crafting prowess and equipment that defies the standard rules of the game, Grid sets out on a journey aimed at escaping poverty, gaining widespread notoriety, and accumulating vast amounts of wealth, completely unaware that his actions will soon disrupt the delicate balance of the entire virtual realm.

Japanese Title: テムパル～アイテムの力～
